about.title: Who I am
about.body: Brazilian front-end engineer from Belo Horizonte, with a playful side that makes art by hand.
about.homeIntro: Hi, I'm {name}. A Brazilian who plays with life and art. This shop is that lighter side: making things by hand, just for the joy of it.
about.intro: I'm {age}, Brazilian, from Belo Horizonte. Professionally I'm a front-end software engineer. You can find that side of me at {portfolio}.
paragraphs: This space, the prints and the handmade pieces, is more of a playful way to live. Not a second career, just curiosity and craft.
Over the years I've made authored works in different forms, taken part in theatre workshops at Pena Escola Arena, and stayed curious about social sciences and cultural production.
I like learning and exploring what life puts in front of me. I have my own way of seeing the world, and sometimes that ends up on paper.
about.contact: Prefer a direct conversation? Message me on WhatsApp. I reply personally.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: This policy explains how Marcos Lucas handles personal data when you inquire about artwork on this shop — especially if you are in the UK or the European Union.
privacy.contact: Questions about your data? Contact Marcos directly on WhatsApp.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: The data controller for this website is Marcos Lucas (individual artist), operating the shop at shop.marcosdelfrari.com. For privacy requests, use the WhatsApp number shown on the Contact section.

sections.title: What data we collect
paragraphs: When you use the inquiry form on a work page, you may provide your name, email address and phone number. You choose what to enter; all three fields are required to continue.
This website does not use analytics, advertising trackers or a user account system. Theme preference (light/dark) may be stored in your browser's local storage only — it is not sent to any server.

sections.title: How your inquiry data is used
paragraphs: Your details are not stored in a database on this website. When you submit the form, they are placed into a pre-filled WhatsApp message so you can send them directly to Marcos.
Marcos uses this information solely to respond to your inquiry about availability, price, shipping to your country and payment arrangements.

sections.title: Legal basis (UK & EU)
paragraphs: Processing is based on your consent when you submit the inquiry form and open WhatsApp, and on Marcos's legitimate interest in responding to purchase enquiries.
Providing your details is voluntary, but without them Marcos cannot reply to your inquiry through the intended channel.

sections.title: Third parties & international transfer
paragraphs: WhatsApp (Meta Platforms) processes the message you send. Their handling of data is governed by their own privacy policy and may involve servers outside your country, including outside the UK/EU.
Marcos does not sell or share your inquiry data with other third parties for marketing.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: Messages retained in WhatsApp or in Marcos's personal records are kept only as long as needed to handle your inquiry, any resulting sale, or legal obligations (e.g. tax records where applicable).

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: If you are in the UK or the EU/EEA, you may have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict or object to processing of your personal data, and to data portability where applicable.
You may withdraw consent at any time by messaging Marcos on WhatsApp. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
